title: 06 · Loam: plant care diary (phone, 390×844 @3x)
strengths: The screen answers one question ('Three plants are thirsty this morning') and the week strip, the hero plant and the 'Also today' list all serve it.
Specific data: Monstera deliciosa, soil moisture 18% 'Dry' on a ten-step bar, 400 ml, Snake plant in the bedroom, 250 ml.
slop_signals: The hero plant is a CC0 line-drawing clipart monstera inside an arched window: the arch frame and the outline-illustration style are the generic 'cozy plant app' template.
Paper-grain texture over the whole page.
The water drop is drawn three times in one card: in the 'Water today' chip, in the week strip, in the 'Log watering' button.
Cream page, terracotta pot and chips, moss green: close to the cream + orange-brown combination the house rule forbids.
Every weekday is its own pill with a drop under it; a plain row of numerals with today filled (Bloom, Fitbit) reads calmer.
fixes: Replace the clipart with a photograph of the plant (or one commissioned-style drawing) in a plain rounded frame; drop the arch.
Keep the drop once (in the chip) and let the button read 'Log 400 ml'.
Shift the clay accent away from orange-brown (a deeper rust, or none) and keep the page neutral.

references.what: Today list with a real plant photo thumbnail, name, species, amount and last watered: no illustration needed.
Serif 'Today', a quiet row of week dots with today filled, one hero card, a soft palette with no clipart.
Cards with a week strip of bars and one number: the same calendar idea without pills.
The playful checklist-with-icons look this piece edges toward; shows where it would land.

owner.said: Hide until it passes at 4 (won the blind test, the reviewer stayed at 3)

changed: Clipart monstera, arch, paper grain and terracotta removed; three free Unsplash plant photos (Kadarius Seegars, feey, Jake Goossen), graded to match
Title states the job ('3 plants to water'); caption 'Most urgent first · 800 ml in all · sensors read at 08:10'
Week strip: numerals with today filled and a count of plants due under each day; the weekday bug fixed (14 Oct 2026 is a Wednesday)
Monty's 18% at Display 48 with a meter showing the healthy band, the 25% watering line and the reading
Every plant: same fields (Latin name, moisture, own watering line) and the same Log action; list ordered by how far below its line
One accent (moss); cool neutral page; iOS type roles; 'Coming up' rows end exactly at the tab bar edge
Fresh-eyes audit: 3/5, 3/5, then 4/5; its last items fixed

facts: art/ (the CC0 line drawings and their CSS) is no longer used by the page; left in place because this session only deletes inside its scratch folder

round4.pairwise: Passes. Ours more premium than all three Greg screens in every round: care list +3, +4, +3, +3; plant page +3, +4, +4, +4 and +4 on the final render; guides +3, +4, +3, +4.

Free Unsplash photo with morning light (Rumman Amin, photo-1544474921-9df05bc76d66), cropped above the pot

round4.fresh_eyes: Does not pass: six fresh-context audits against the B2B product screens, none reached 4. Facts (times, dates, counts, Italian) confirmed correct each time; the verdict is design, not data.
